s1.desc: an igloo living room with pale ice-brick walls, a cream sofa and a glass coffee table

spans.view: with a wooden door in the ice-brick wall behind her

beats.text: Polly sits on the sofa holding up {ifin} and tapping at its screen
Polly reaches down for the charging cable lying beside her on the sofa
Polly plugs the cable into the bottom of her phone
Polly leans over and lays the phone down on the sofa cushion, then sits back up
Polly hops down off the sofa and stands with her eyes closed

spans.notes: locked: ECC on the door band (y 0.30-0.58, x 0.75-1.0) scale 1.0000, <=0.3 px, cc 1.000 every 5 frames to f60, and on the coffee-table band (y 0.68-0.92) 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 every 3 frames to f63; the door's colour centroid holds at 963 px f0-65 and moves at f66. The phone is the iFin (full-res crop f20: pale grey back, three lenses, tuft on top). Top third plain ice-brick wall, bottom fifth floor and table: no overlay

spans.view: with a wooden door in the ice-brick wall behind her

beats.text: Polly waddles to the right past the wooden door toward a small side table with a coral purse on it

spans.notes: tracking pan right: the door slides left ~26 px a frame (centroid 963 -> 210 px f65-95) while Polly stays near the middle, so travel none. Filled for U3

spans.view: with a wooden door in the ice-brick wall behind her

beats.text: Polly lifts the coral purse off the side table and hangs it from her flipper
Polly waddles back to the left toward the sofa, carrying the coral purse

spans.notes: tracking pan left with eased ends: door centroid 210 -> 880 px f110-150 (0.6 px/frame at f111, ~30 px/frame mid-move, 2 px/frame by f149); Polly stays near the middle, so travel none. Filled for U3

spans.view: with the cream sofa beside her and a wooden door in the ice-brick wall behind

beats.text: Polly, with the coral purse on her flipper, reaches over to the phone lying on the sofa
Polly picks up the phone, still plugged into the cable, and looks down at it
Polly pulls the phone free of the cable and hugs it to her chest

spans.view: with a wooden door in the ice-brick wall ahead of her

beats.text: Polly turns around, holding the phone up to her face
Polly waddles away toward the wooden door with her back turned, the coral purse on her flipper
